## Technical privacy observations

Actual form paths use the existing Web3Forms configuration, directly or through the existing selected-design/Shop validation relay. WhatsApp links prepare a manual message and require the customer to send it. No selected design files/attachments are submitted. Private D1/R2/staff features remain disabled. Source/static resource scans of homepage, FAQ, quote, booking, subscription and Media Kit found no external script/image/iframe/font hosts in their markup. This does not prove the absence of hosting/provider cookies or remote account configuration.

No real business-inbox access or private cloud storage account audit was available. Actual email receipt, live security headers/HTTPS, remote storage controls and physical-device/assistive-technology behaviour are NOT TESTED. Safe condition: keep private features disabled, no production publication, and conduct controlled recipient and live-origin checks before release.
